about_the_game:
The Overlord has awakened, and his skeletal legions rise from the grave! In Tomb of the Overlord, up to four players venture into cursed crypts, fight through waves of undead, and uncover lost knowledge to grow stronger. Choose your starting class, then expand your abilities through a deep multiclass system, combining attacks, spells, auras, summons, and other powerful abilities to create your perfect build. Will you become an unstoppable warrior-mage, a cunning rogue-priest, or something entirely unique?

Each run brings new challenges, new loot, and new ways to master the battlefield. Team up with friends or go solo in your quest to put the Overlord back in his grave—before he drags the world down with him!

Key Features

  • 1-4 Player Co-op – Brave the tombs alone or with friends in online co-op.

  • Multiclass System – Mix and match attacks, spells, auras, and summons from different classes to create your own playstyle.

  • Deep Ability Customization – Unlock devastating melee strikes, ranged spells, lingering auras, summoned minions, and other abilities as you level up.

  • Dynamic Combat – Engage in real-time battles with fluid movement, dodge mechanics, and skill-based attacks.

  • Dynamic Exploration – Discover areas that may change with hidden secrets, randomized elements, and event-driven paths leading to new challenges every attempt.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 370 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard DirectX-compatible soundcard

short_description: Delve into the depths of the Tomb of the Overlord, a co-op action RPG where you battle relentless undead, master powerful classes, and forge your own path through multiclass progression.
